Brian, saw Placer.ai crossed $100M ARR and named a new CMO this year.

That growth means more in-market accounts than you can personally research and follow up on, so good leads slip while you write. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and follow-up, so you spend time in conversations instead: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to three of Placer.ai's top strategic accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?

Brian, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

As a strategic SDR, the bottleneck is usually follow-up volume and response speed, not effort. There are more accounts than hours, and the deepest research is exactly what eats the day.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent. I'll bring specifics for Placer.ai.

Brian, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Placer.ai's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth startups. Want to grab time and I'll walk you through it?

Brian, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If getting more capacity on your strategic accounts without more headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. I know a fast-scaling team keeps you plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic SDR motion? I'll tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
